notes.content:

notes.title: Update Round Up and Autumn Sale!
notes.content:
Patched and Improved so far + time for biggest sale yet.
[list]
[*] You no longer have to watch the intro scene every time you launch the game and haven't passed the tutorial.
[*] Tutorial no longer obligatory. The first level is now unlocked without the necessity to go trough the tutorial, although it's recommended to get familiar with the few basic rules of the game. 
[*] Improved loading time of the game's launch. Game now launches up to 30% faster.
[*] Fixed tutorial text appearing outside of the blur box on 21:9 ratios.
[*]Mouse no longer goes off window when playing on windowed or on multi-monitor setup. 
[*]An easter egg regarding the game music is now more evident. 
[*]Optimized camera effects. 
[*] All story scenes are now skippable. [b]Press ESC[/b] to skip the current cut scene and load the next level immediately.
[*] Added option in the settings menu to turn ON/OFF the [b]Motion Blur effect[/b].
[*] SSX-14 loading scene now gets the next level a lot faster.
[/list]
